title: Cracked work bow/would not start!
text:
Cracked work bow/would not start!. Crack in work bowl. This happened at Hamilton Beach, in packing.

Re-ordered. Would not start. Returned. Hamilton-Beach customer service, never called me back.

Maybe they should make their appliances in the US.

product_metadata.title: Hamilton Beach Big Mouth Duo Plus 12 Cup Food Processor & Vegetable Chopper with Additional Mini 4 Cup Bowl, Black (70580)
features: DUAL-BOWL VERSATILITY: The 12 cup bowl on the Hamilton Beach food processor is ideal for larger batches, slicing and shredding, and the smaller 4 cup bowl works great as a vegetable chopper. The two bowls conveniently nest together for compact storage.

SAVE PREP TIME — FITS WHOLE FOOD. You'll save time and reduce the need for precutting every time you process food with this small chopper/food processor chopper because you can fit whole tomatoes, potatoes and onions in the Big Mouth feed chute.

SLICE, SHRED, CHOP, MIX AND PUREE: With this 12 cup food processor, you get a reversible slicing/shredding disc for slicing and shredding and a versatile S-blade that lets you chop, mix or puree food.
EASY TO CLEAN: The simple touchpad on this food processor is easy to wipe clean, and all removable parts are dishwasher safe for easy cleanup. All food zones are BPA free for your peace of mind.

PROCESS TOUGH INGREDIENTS WITH POWERFUL 500 WATT MOTOR: The 500 watt motor packs plenty of power to process all types of ingredients, and the 2 speeds plus pulse provide all the control you need for slicing, shredding, chopping, mixing, and pureeing.
description: With an extra-large Feed tube, In-bowl blade storage, A powerful motor with 3 speed Plus pulse, and dishwasher-safe parts, the Hamilton Beach big mouth duo Plus 12-Cup food Processor & vegetable chopper with additional small 4-cup bowl is the ultimate kitchen appliance.
